common.dismiss: Names the button that closes a notification banner.
common.close: Names the button that closes the full-screen image viewer.
common.previous: Names the button that moves back one item in a carousel or image viewer.
common.next: Names the button that moves forward one item in a carousel or image viewer.
common.show_more_items: Describes the "Show More" button. `%{count}` = how many further items it reveals, and selects the plural form.
common.breadcrumb: Names the trail of parent links above a page title.
common.primary_navigation: Names the site's main menu, so it can be told apart from the other menus on the page.
common.footer_navigation: Names the footer's untitled list of links. A footer column that shows its own heading is named by that heading instead.
common.opens_in_new_tab_suffix: Warns that a link opens a new browser tab, and is read directly after the link's own words. Takes no placeholder, because the link's text is arbitrary. Keep the brackets if the language uses them.
common.menu: Names the button in the top bar that opens the site menu on a phone. The same name is read whether the menu is open or closed.

errors.error_icon: Names the warning icon above an error message.

article.filter_label: Names the row of tag filter chips above an article index.

meditation.mute_voice: Names the button that silences the spoken guidance.
meditation.unmute_voice: Names the same button once the guidance is silenced.
meditation.mute_music: Names the button that silences the background music.
meditation.unmute_music: Names the same button once the music is silenced.
meditation.voice_volume: Names the slider controlling the spoken guidance.
meditation.music_volume: Names the slider controlling the background music.
meditation.audio_settings: Names the panel holding the volume sliders.
meditation.shuffle_music: Names the button that picks a different background track at random.
meditation.related_lectures_loading: Announced while the suggested talks are still loading.
meditation.finder_region: Names the region of the page holding the mood picker.

lecture.related_meditations_loading: Announced while the suggested meditations are still loading.
lecture.untitled_heading: Stands in as the page heading for a talk that carries no title of its own.

map.classes_heading: Names the list of classes on a region page.
map.when: Introduces a class's day and time.
map.languages: Introduces the languages a class is taught in.

forms.submitting: Announced while a form is being sent.
forms.required_marker: Replaces the asterisk marking a mandatory field. One word.

media.play: Names the button that starts playback.
media.pause: Names the same button during playback.
media.previous_track: Names the button that goes back to the previous track.
media.next_track: Names the button that skips to the next track.
media.toggle_shuffle: Names the button that turns random order on or off.
media.mute: Names the button that silences the player.
media.unmute: Names the same button once the player is silenced.
media.play_item: Names the play button on a card. `%{title}` = that item's own title.
media.view_image: Names the button that opens an image full screen, when the image has no caption.
media.view_image_alt: The same button when the image has a caption. `%{alt}` = that caption, which the editor writes.
media.embed_code: Names the box holding the embed code.
media.zoom_in: Names the button that enlarges an image in the full-screen viewer.
media.zoom_out: Names the button that shrinks an image in the full-screen viewer.
media.progress: Names the audio player's progress slider, which moves playback within the track.

location.selected_label: Names the box showing the place already chosen.
location.change_label: Names the button that changes the chosen place.

blocks.enter_fullscreen: Names the button that opens the subtle-system diagram full screen.
blocks.exit_fullscreen: Names the same button while the diagram fills the screen.
blocks.learn_more_about: Names the "Learn More" link. `%{title}` = the chakra or channel it leads to.
blocks.previous_slide: Names the button that goes back one slide in a carousel.
blocks.next_slide: Names the button that advances one slide in a carousel.
blocks.previous_column: Names the button that scrolls to the previous column. `%{title}` = that column's heading.
blocks.next_column: Names the button that scrolls to the next column. `%{title}` = that column's heading.
blocks.go_to_column: Names a dot that jumps to one column. `%{number}` = its position, `%{title}` = its heading.
blocks.quote: Names a pull-quote block that carries no heading.
blocks.table_of_contents: Names the in-page contents list when it carries no heading.
blocks.share_region: Names the whole sharing area at the end of a page.
blocks.share_group: Names the row of sharing buttons inside that area.
blocks.share_on: Names one sharing button. `%{platform}` = the network's own name, untranslated.
blocks.next_session: Read in place of the live-class countdown's digits: the one sentence giving the next class's day, time and how far away it is. `%{weekday}` = the day, `%{time}` = the start time, `%{relative}` = how far away, e.g. "in 2 days".
